visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed dark banner: a full-width background image with a dark overlay, containing a large heading, a subheading and a single CTA button, rounded corners.
contentPattern: Row 1: background image. Row 2 (or subsequent cell): heading + subheading + CTA link overlaid on the image.
usage: Closing call-to-action banner with a background image, headline and CTA.
